_note: First-visit tips, shown once per screen. Each step is a short list of bullet points (a plain string also works). Placeholders in {braces} are filled from the current level so the text never goes stale: {goal}, {mass_kg}, {budget}, {deadline}, {weeks}, {goal_mb}, {reserve_pct}.

briefing.title: Briefing
steps: Goal: {goal}
Mass: at most {mass_kg} kg
Budget: {budget}
Launch by day {deadline}
[locked] Grey choices are locked in this mission
[locked] Click one to see why

workshop.title: Workshop
steps: Click a part in the tray to fit it
Or drag it onto the satellite
Yellow slot = required and still empty
Six bars check your design
Green = fine, yellow = close, red = fails
Hover a bar or press Why red? for the reason
The clock is running: every day costs money
Removing a fitted part costs rework time
Deadline: day {deadline}. Pause stops the clock
Stay under {mass_kg} kg and {budget}
Press Test it when the bars are green

test_lab.title: Test lab
steps: Every requirement is tested
PASS = fine, FAIL = a problem
Fix it: back to the workshop (costs days)
Launch anyway: risky, and each failure has a cost in orbit

ops.title: Operations
steps: The satellite flies for {weeks} weeks
Goal: {goal_mb} MB delivered to the ground
Safe mode: no data, the battery recovers
Smaller files: storage fills slower
Extra pass: costs money, sends more
Events pop up with a timer
What you built changes how they turn out
Watch the fuel meter

report.title: Report
steps: Star 1: reach the goal
Star 2: pass every check
Star 3: keep {reserve_pct}% of the budget
Why it happened: what went wrong, step by step
Fix my satellite keeps your parts

puzzle_mass.title: Puzzle 1: Mass
steps: A rocket slot holds only 3.6 kg
Pack a camera, panels, a battery and a radio
Press Launch it to see what happens

puzzle_power.title: Puzzle 2: Power
steps: Every orbit: 60 minutes of sunlight, 35 of darkness
Panels refill the battery in the sun
The battery keeps you alive in the dark

puzzle_link.title: Puzzle 3: Data link
steps: The camera makes more than the radio can send
Switch ideas on and off
The narrowest pipe sets the pace

puzzle_time.title: Puzzle 4: Budget and time
steps: Build, test, licence, ship
Every day costs money
Press Play the year: real surprises will hit

missions.title: Missions
steps: 20 missions, each based on a real spaceflight
One star opens the next mission
Every 7 missions is a stage
17 of its 21 stars opens the next stage
A mission with no stars costs a life
Lives come back every 30 minutes
3 stars = 500 star dust; 1500 buys a life

truck.title: The NASA problem
steps: Robots at the Moon's south pole must drive themselves
The Sun is low: long shadows, dark craters, dust
Pick sensors: each one is blind somewhere
Every condition must say Covered
Press Drive test to watch the rover
Pass it to open challenge 2

route.title: Plan the route
steps: Move with WASD or the arrow keys
Or click the square next to the end of the path
Sunlight charges the battery; shadow and craters drain it
The sensors can't see rocks in digging dust
Backspace undoes a step, Enter drives
Finish all 3 sets to open challenge 3

shadows.title: Moving shadows
steps: The Sun circles low round the horizon
so the shadows move as you plan
Space (or Wait) stays put for a step
Waiting in sunlight charges the battery
Cross when the shadow has moved off your path
Enter drives; 3 sets, each a little harder
